jobs.title: Senior Gameplay Audio Software Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Founded in 2023, Small Axe Studios is 2K’s newest stand-alone studio, built to push the boundaries of game development and bring 2K’s next groundbreaking sports franchise to life. Headquartered in Burnaby, we are assembling a world-class team of visionaries, builders, and passionate gamers who thrive on creative collaboration, technical excellence, and bold ideas. At Small Axe Studios, we believe big things start with sharp focus—and we’re crafting an exceptional, player-first experience from the ground up. If you’re ready to tackle unique challenges, leave your mark on a brand-new IP, and help shape the future of interactive sports entertainment, we want you on our team! WHAT WE NEED Our studio in Vancouver is seeking a Senior Audio / AI Software Engineer to join our development team in working on a new AAA Sports game. This role will partner with engineers from all game areas, audio artists, and designers. Within this role, you will be focused on writing new AI analysis logic, tools, and workflows to support the audio design team. WHAT YOU’LL DO Implement and debug core C++ game logic for audio features, such as dynamic crowd reactions, player-specific commentary, and contextual sound effects (SFX) Work closely with Gameplay Engineers (AI, Animation) and Audio Designers to integrate new audio systems with game behavior and animation pipelines Drive development of tools and workflows that leverage AI analysis to provide necessary data for the Audio team Contribute to a large, performant C++ codebase, participating in code reviews and embracing a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement WHAT WILL MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience 5+ years of professional experience, or significant academic/personal project experience, writing C++ code for gameplay systems or large-scale applications Proficiency in C++ and object-oriented programming is important, with a foundational understanding of game engine principles (ideally Unreal Engine) Familiarity with AI, game/team-based behavior systems, and a passion for sports is a strong plus Excellent 3D math and linear algebra skills A commitment to writing clean, well-documented, and efficient code, paired with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to non-technical partners (Art, Design, Production) BENEFICIAL QUALIFICATIONS Experience developing and shipping AAA games on Unreal Engine 4 and 5 Familiarity with Python and/or C# The pay range for this position in British Columbia at the start of employment is expected to be between $99,800 and $147,680 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for employees in regular roles may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/ or other benefits, provided that temporary or intern roles will not be eligible for many of these payments or benefits. Details of participation in compensation and benefit plans (if applicable) will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or indivi dual department/team performance, and market factors. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are p rovided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation. Please note t hat 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.

jobs.title: Assistant Audio Producer, Dateline (contract)
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description: NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world. Dateline NBC is seeking a creative Assistant Audio Producer to help our team produce several weekly podcasts. PLEASE NOTE: This is a short-term position with an estimated duration of 24 months or less, unless otherwise amended or terminated as deliverables within this project are completed. Responsibilities Monitor breaking crime news and gather elements for coverage Research crime issues and crime stories for both long-term and breaking stories Schedule guests and talent for remote interviews and tracking sessions Factcheck episodes Assist with finding guests Assist with music cue sheets for each episode Coordinate shipping and return of audio equipment to guests and talent At least 1 year of podcast experience preferred Demonstrated writing ability and experience Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills, and attention to detail Prompt and professional communication style Familiarity with audio file types, fluency with methods of capture in-studio, in the field, and remotely Experience using Descript and Riverside.fm is a plus Video editing experience a plus Bachelor’s degree in a related field Working knowledge of CMS systems Additional Requirements: Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, which currently requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. What we’ll offer: Production Employee (PEP) Regular who works more than 1,000 hours per measurement period: Eligible for 401K after 1,000 hours worked in 12 consecutive months Eligible for Health and Welfare benefits on 1st day of employment Eligible to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program after 90 days of employment Salary range: $26/hr - $31/hr As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

jobs.title: Sound Designer
jobs.description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: Ludios About Ludios Ludios takes its name from Latin; it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games. Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in. Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about. If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you. Role Overview As a Sound Designer at Ludios, you'll be responsible for creating, editing, and implementing audio components for our portfolio of games. You will collaborate with our creative teams to craft an immersive audio experience that compliments the game's visuals and gameplay. Key Responsibilities: Create original and engaging sound design for games, including gameplay actions, user interface interactions, animations, rewards, transitions, and other in-game moments. Take ownership of sound design across multiple features and projects, from initial concept through final delivery. Edit, mix, and master audio to produce polished, balanced results across different devices. Collaborate closely with game designers, artists, developers, producers, and other members of the audio team. Communicate effectively with international colleagues, particularly teams based in London, Barcelona, and Australia. Interpret creative briefs, propose suitable audio direction, and respond constructively to feedback. Review audio within the game, identify areas for improvement, and iterate until the sound supports the intended player experience. Organize audio assets and project files clearly, following consistent naming and delivery practices. Manage priorities and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines. Contribute positively to team discussions and support a collaborative working environment. Requirements : Strong sound design, sound editing, and mixing skills. A good understanding of audio processing, including equalization, compression, dynamics, spatial effects, and level balancing. Proficiency with at least one professional digital audio workstation. Music composition and production skills Ability to create a complete audio experience using sound effects, audio libraries, voice-over, music, recording, layering, and creative processing. A strong ear for detail, timing, tonal balance, and how sound supports visual feedback and the player experience. Openness to learning and adopting new audio tools, technologies, and workflows. Ability to interpret a creative brief and independently develop an appropriate audio direction. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including confidence working with colleagues across different locations and time zones. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks or projects. A reliable and constructive approach to teamwork and feedback. Nice to Have Previous experience creating audio for games, particularly mobile or casual games. An understanding of mobile audio limitations, file optimization, loudness, and playback consistency across devices. Experience with collaborative asset-management workflows. Working at Tripledot Hybrid Working 20 days of remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year. Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements, and our team spirit. Breakfast & Lunch: Relish daily breakfast and lunch provided in the office to keep you fueled and focused. BPJS HEALTH: Elevate your well-being and peace of mind, ensuring robust health security with seamless enrolment in BPJS Health. BPJS SOCIAL: Secure your employment rights with BPJS Social. Festivity Allowance: Celebrate festive occasions with an additional festive allowance. Private Health Insurance: Stay covered with comprehensive health insurance for you and your loved ones. Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand. Family Forming Support: Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy] English Classes: Enhance your English skills with our provided English classes View our recruitment privacy policy here

jobs.title: Senior Tech QA Analyst - Audio
jobs.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Tech QA Analyst - Audio to take ownership of quality, stability and performance across our shared audio technologies. Working closely with Audio Code, Sound Design, Music and QA teams, you will be responsible for validating complex audio systems, investigating difficult technical problems and building effective testing solutions. You will work across C++, Unreal Engine and Wwise, using debugging and profiling tools to understand not only when something fails, but why. As a Senior, you will own complex technical quality topics end-to-end, make risk-based recommendations, develop testing and automation solutions, improve pipelines and practices, and help other QA team members grow their technical capabilities. Responsibilities Oversee the stability, performance, and quality of shared audio systems throughout the entire development lifecycle. Create comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans to identify technical risks early and define effective validation approaches. Conduct deep-dive investigations and root-cause analysis on complex audio issues using C++, Unreal Engine, and Wwise. Monitor and validate audio system performance metrics, including CPU usage, memory, streaming, and runtime behavior. Design and maintain automated testing solutions, functional test environments, and debugging tools to increase investigation efficiency. Work closely with Audio Code and Design teams to evaluate technical solutions and provide data-driven quality recommendations. Drive improvements to testing pipelines, workflows, and QA practices by researching and integrating new testing technologies. Manage technical QA efforts across in-house and external teams to ensure consistent coverage for complex audio features. Elevate team capabilities through clear technical documentation, knowledge sharing, workshops, and mentoring. 5+ years of professional experience in technical QA, software testing, or game development with a focus on complex technical systems. Proven track record of owning quality, stability, and performance for technical features throughout the development cycle. Strong practical knowledge of Unreal Engine and C++, with the ability to read, investigate, and debug production code. Proficiency with audio middleware like Wwise, including technical debugging and performance profiling. Expertise in using diagnostic and profiling tools such as Unreal Insights, PIX, or Razor to analyze performance data, logs, and traces. Experience designing and implementing automated or programmatic testing solutions, pipelines, and internal tools. Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis across complex systems to identify and resolve technical issues. Skill in designing comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans for technically complex features. Ability to assess technical quality risks and data-driven insights to make actionable recommendations. Nice to have Professional experience in game audio technology, technical audio, or Audio QA with a shipped PC or console title. Hands-on programming experience, including implementing fixes, tooling, or production features. Expertise in creating test frameworks, internal QA tools, and custom testing infrastructure. Experience with automated testing integrated into CI or development pipelines. Strong understanding of audio programming concepts (DSP, mixing, streaming, voice management) and engine-level performance optimization. Advanced Wwise skills, including integration, optimization, and complex profiling. Experience creating debug levels, instrumentation, or visualization tools for complex systems. Working mode Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time or hybrid mode. Relocation Support Relocation package – flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet, shipping your belongings — it’s all covered. Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you, assistance with finding residence, tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Health & Well-Being Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majority paid by the company. Perks & Professional Growth A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has  electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog. A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. Estimated pay range for this position: 17 800 - 27 800 PLN gross monthly. Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications. Contract type in Poland: Employment contract (umowa o pracę) If you've observed any irregularities (i.e. legal or ethical violations) in our recruitment process, please click here to report them anonymously. #LI_Hybrid
